## Concept, owners and closure

The changed concept is physical receipt/draft/intent/settlement observation
authority in the served channel helper chain, not send eligibility or lifecycle
policy. The working class is the complete finite38-declaration caller chain in
family145-channel-settlement-preimages.json (15 files). The parent class remains
all test-owned persistence authority; this is an incremental migration, not
parent closure. The original debt issue is class-shaped, not one flaky symptom.

Canonical SQL owners after this change:

| Owner | Exhaustive touched consumption |
| --- | --- |
| channeldelivery | latest-current card receipt; closed text/action response receipt; acknowledged current draft render; exact pending/settled intent aggregate; unsettled responsibility via existing canonical predicates; delivery state, fresh-copy/card-copy/uncertain-source counts; historical/current render facts; five fixed settlement-diagnostic projections |
| decisioncard | draft status, seven-column draft/card physical state, global/three-card decision counts, exact card run-id and physical snapshot |
| effectpersistence | two bounded channel-delivery operation/attempt diagnostic projections |
| existing selected native read coordinator and ChannelObservation | all named private bridge operations and detached public observations; one harness-owned lifetime, no raw pool/dialect/SQL/transaction/callback exposure |

The committed finite manifest records every changed caller's signed Before and
exact After. Typed transformation rejects aliases, callbacks, shadowed helpers,
package-initializer references, excluded-source references, side-effecting
arguments and changed query shapes. The whole-transform control validates all38
declarations against the signed predecessor. There are23 exact existing-history
advances and15 appends: original Before/metadata/order survive. Source-only
inverses compose at tools and store live ingress; the one observation-interface
embedding has an exact full-byte inverse. Neither inverse changes debt identity
or grants deletion credit. Old source manifests and historical accounting pairs
remain immutable. The collector fingerprint remains b5bdd1d92df22693c570dab217a46c8a184f37085f496653d59b732c12399a4d.

Old caller SQL and raw derivative arguments in the38-declaration manifest are
non-authoritative after migration. The isolated-schema responsibility adapter,
its raw diagnostic path and the six-domain budget scanner intentionally survive
as visible debt. The selected/live settlement wait and diagnostic callers do
not use those raw paths. The separate intent observer's process-close/reopen
ordering is unchanged; a harness storage inspector does not acquire execution
authority or become a process-bound observer.

The authoritative platform-spec.yaml channel_settlement_storage_observation
entry records these bounded observation contracts; runtime policy is unchanged.
The larger tail is the resulting real census, not a forecast from the275-site
opportunity inventory. The deferred budget scanner is the next batch; this
batch makes no scanner, restart, strict-zero or integrated landing claim.

## Remaining obligations and architecture feedback

Sibling scopes checked: card versus text/action, draft cancellation/partial
input, historical versus current render/receipt, recovery after actual process
replacement, global versus per-card counts, accepted effects after source loss,
absence versus cancellation/owner close, and diagnostic truncation/privacy.

Achieved closure is the finite observation chain, not elimination of all channel
raw authority. Parent #2542/#2151 remains open. The watchlist disposition stays
the existing selected-persistence-authority node; no new issue or duplicate
watchlist is warranted. Architecture feedback stays in #2542: generic raw failure
scanners and incidental derivative DB arguments spread observation authority.
The long-run direction is the existing domain-owned bounded read ports, not a
new generic observation framework. The six-domain scanner is a small follow-on
batch; broader construction/fault/lifecycle debt remains separately inventoried.
Expected ROI is reduced future fixture repair fan-out, not faster execution or
proven runtime correctness beyond these unchanged contracts.

Pre-batch event-count, two Template9 workflow-state and deployment-propagation
guard holds remain unwaived. M01, Docker, SQLite fork deadlines, final strict
completion guards and full integrated qualification remain open. This is not a
review-ready PR artifact or a substitute for the final PR proof audit.
